notes: The Communications page was rewritten at Leon's request: much of it describes technology
that no longer exists. Post and internet are also different topics, so they split.
Dropped from this half: 'postman' (a duplicate of mailman), 'mailbag', 'parcel post',
'special delivery' and 'regular mail' — service names a learner will not meet.
